confidence_notes: I based the restaurant meal, cappuccino and draft beer anchors on two web searches. They returned aggregated cost-of-living data (Numbeo as of June 2026, plus 2026 Melbourne cost guides): inexpensive meal about AUD 25-25.5, mid-range three-course meal for two about AUD 120-123, cappuccino about AUD 5-5.8, and draft beer about AUD 10-13.3 depending on the source. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. Those two are estimates based on how they usually compare with beer in Australia (cocktail about 1.8x beer, wine glass slightly above beer), so they are less certain. All four accommodation anchors are general estimates for Melbourne in July 2026, which is winter there; I did not check any listings. They are the least certain anchors. The FX value is the RBA 4pm reference rate for 2026-11-18, as reported by search results. I did not open the RBA page directly, and the rate was published after the July 2026 pricing window.
comparable_city_reasoning: I used Melbourne's own aggregated price data where it was available. For the other anchors I compared Melbourne with Sydney and Brisbane, which are large, high-cost Australian cities with similar hospitality and accommodation markets. Melbourne prices are slightly below Sydney's.
